confidence_reason: The revocation of EO 14020 and the dissolution of the Gender Policy Council were confirmed in the Federal Register text of EO 14168. The absence of a life and family coordinator rests on a Wikipedia appointment list and a limited search, which affects the progress figure rather than the stage.

durability.why: The council was created and abolished by executive order, so a later President can recreate it.

est_completion.basis: Inference: the revocation of EO 14020 is done by EO 14168, so the only open step is naming a life-and-family coordinator at Special Assistant rank or higher, a White House staffing choice that needs no rule or Senate vote. Driving step: that designation, for which the record found no sign in about 20 months; the post may also exist without having been reported. Because it could occur at any time, 2027 is a low-confidence placeholder and not a scheduled date.

review.mandate_note: Page 62 asks the President to immediately revoke EO 14020 and every policy, including subregulatory guidance, tied to the Gender Policy Council, and to appoint a Special Assistant to the President or higher to coordinate life and family priorities with the Domestic Policy Council; the paraphrase is accurate.

source_checks.note: EO 14168 (signed 2025-01-20, 90 FR 8615): Sec. 7(b) rescinds EOs 13988, 14004, 14020, 14021 and 14075 and dissolves the Gender Policy Council; Sec. 7(c) lists Education, DOJ and EEOC guidance to rescind. The Federal Register's EO notes list only four rescinded orders, omitting 14020, but the order text includes it. The order creates no life and family post.

Red-team evidence checked: Domestic Policy Council director and White House Faith Office posts are listed, and no position title mentions life or family. A Wikipedia list is not a complete staff record.

status_summary: EO 14168, signed 2025-01-20, revokes EO 14020, which created the Gender Policy Council, and dissolves the council; it also revokes four other Biden-era orders on gender identity and equity (EOs 13988, 14004, 14021 and 14075) and directs agencies to rescind named guidance documents, mainly on LGBTQI+ students, Title IX and workplace harassment. The Mandate's second recommendation, a Special Assistant-level or higher coordinator for life and family priorities working with the Domestic Policy Council, was not found: a Wikipedia list of Executive Office appointments shows Domestic Policy Council and White House Faith Office staff but no such post. Whether every Council product was rescinded was not checked.

timeline.event: EO 14168 signed: Section 7 revokes EO 14020 (Gender Policy Council) and four other orders and dissolves the council; agency heads are to rescind inconsistent guidance promptly.
EO 14168 published in the Federal Register (90 FR 8615).

title: Revoke the Gender Policy Council order and create a life and family coordinator
uncertainties: Only the Federal Register text of EO 14168 was read for the revocation. A search and a Wikipedia list of Executive Office appointments (secondary, not the White House staff list) show no life and family coordinator; the White House Faith Office exists but has a different remit. Absence from that list is not proof that no such role exists. Lawsuits against EO 14168 concern its other provisions, not the council's dissolution.
